## About
Cylinder Head Depot is a family-owned business. Our grandfather was in the rebuilding business, our father took it over and specialized in rebuilding engines, and when we came in we changed the name to Cylinder Head Depot and went full force into the rebuilding of cylinder heads. Along the way we invested in welding equipment, pressure testers, and schooling on how to weld and do crack repair enhancement.
We service the automotive, truck, marine, diesel, motorcycle, and industrial industries from our shop on South State Road 7, in the heart of Broward County between Miami and West Palm Beach. We sell, exchange, and service new, used, and reconditioned cylinder heads, and we keep gasket sets, cams, valves, rockers, springs, and other engine-related parts on hand.
We're rated 4.8 from 117 Google reviews, and one reviewer called us one of the last true old school head shops around. We are always striving to give you a better product. Thank you for choosing us for your cylinder head needs. Steve and Greg

## Services
- Cylinder heads exchanged: Swap your head for one of ours. We sell, exchange, and service new, used, and reconditioned cylinder heads.
- Cylinder head diamond resurfacing: One reviewer said his head came back diamond cut and cleaned and looked better than brand new.
- Performance 3- and 5-angle valve jobs: Valve work done in house by our machinists.
- In-house welding and flywheel grinding: Welding and crack repair are part of what we do every day.
- Blocks, bored, honed, and decked: Block work to go along with your head refresh.
- Computerized straightening: Straightening done on our own equipment.
- Shot blasting and hydroblast cleaning: Parts cleaned down before the machine work starts.
- R & R of U Joints and press bushings: Press work too. One reviewer brought in upper control arms for his Dodge to have new bushings and ball joints installed, and they were done in less than a day.

## FAQ
Q: What kinds of engines do you work on?
A: Cylinder head rebuilding, repair, exchange, and reconditioning for cars, trucks, boats, motorcycles, jet skis, fork lifts, and generators.

Q: Do you work on diesel heads?
A: Yes. We specialize in diesel 6.0 and 6.4 cylinder heads.

Q: How much will my job cost?
A: Give us a call or send an email and we'll go over pricing and availability with you.
